recent_en: Pantech Global reported strong year-on-year growth in revenue and net profit for the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, and declared a first interim dividend of 2.2 sen per share. The company also proposed to dispose of its former expansion land in Klang for RM31,731,000. Directors have recently reported acquisitions of shares in the open market.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of freehold land held by wholly-owned subsidiary Pantech Steel Industries for RM31,731,000.
Declared first interim single-tier dividend of 2.2 sen per share for FY2027.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 31 Aug 2026, with net profit nearly doubling year-on-year.
risks_en: Directors filed notices of intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
Several recent filings on directors' dealings and changes in director's interest.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, revenue was RM173,707,000, up 38.3% year-on-year and 8.8% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM19,332,000, up 60.8% year-on-year and 18.2% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 11.1%, higher than 10.2% in the previous quarter.
